scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.share: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,tunnel "npm run start -w server" "cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://localhost:3001"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
